Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: test event
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A test event raised from the dev menu.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Test event involving {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: war declared
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Two factions have become hostile.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} and {1} are now at war

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: peace made
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Two hostile factions are no longer at war.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} and {1} end hostilities

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: alliance formed
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Two factions have become allies.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} and {1} become allies

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: leader died
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction's leader has died.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: The leader of {0} has died

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: alliance broken
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: An alliance between two factions has ended.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} ends its alliance with {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: riots
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Unrest has turned into riots. Stability and legitimacy fall, and the economy suffers.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Riots break out in {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: coup
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: The military or a palace faction has seized power and installed a new leader.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Coup in {0}: a new leader seizes power

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: revolution
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: The government has fallen to a revolution. A new leader and a new form of government take over.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Revolution in {0}: the government falls

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: capital lost
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has lost its capital, destroyed or captured. Stability and legitimacy fall sharply.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} loses its capital

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: new capital
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has moved its seat of government.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} proclaims a new capital

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: news correction
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Earlier reports have turned out to be false.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Earlier reports about {0} were false

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: treaty signed
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Two factions have signed a treaty.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} and {1} sign a treaty: {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: treaty cancelled
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has formally withdrawn from a treaty.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} withdraws from its {2} with {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: treaty broken
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has broken a treaty. Every faction thinks less of it.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} breaks its {2} with {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: treaty expired
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A treaty has run its course.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: The {2} between {0} and {1} expires

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: embargo declared
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has stopped all trade with another.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} declares an embargo on {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: embargo lifted
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has resumed trade with another.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} lifts its embargo on {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: border policy changed
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has changed its border policy toward another.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} sets its borders with {1} to {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: denunciation
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has publicly denounced another.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} denounces {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: tribute paid
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has paid tribute under threat.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} pays tribute of {2} silver to {1}
